digest.component_or_area: capability enforcement and optional dependency management
propositions: A semantic capability registry must be created in stdlib-only form that maps capability keys to packaging extras and typed missing postures (error, unavailable, abstain, fallback), independent of the command registry.

Capability enforcement must occur at selected execution boundaries after mode/backend selection (e.g., audit serve before audit show; Bedrock/Jira DC/S3 client construction) rather than at route discovery or top-level help.
Stable commands and top-level help must remain executable in a no-extras wheel, with only the selected capability boundary emitting an actionable error for error-posture capabilities.

The shared error helper must be invoked only after existing handlers/factories parse the selected mode/backend; domain components retain control of result payloads and logging for unavailable, abstain, and fallback postures.

Every capability must reference exactly one declared packaging extra, no probe module may be imported during registry construction or validation, and mcp_server and review_bot must remain separate entry points without CLI routes.
